bounded_context: Adamas bootstrap test and diagnostic harness

change.summary: Admit bootstrap evidence only from fresh provenance-bound artifacts and label partial telemetry or normalized IR comparisons conservatively.
admitted: fresh output directory with atomic run manifest
source, producer, output, flags, time, host, cache, smoke, and contextual environment fingerprints
numeric RSS and FD maxima only for complete observed process-tree samples
IR_SHAPE_EQ for hash-verified normalized textual equality
rejected: reused stage directories as a new epoch
exit-zero production without a fresh artifact
numeric zero or parent-only maxima for unavailable process-tree telemetry
SEMANTIC_EQ as a label for normalized textual equality

compatibility: Existing callers must use a fresh output directory. IR comparison now requires bootstrap_stages.manifest. The resource line is additive and existing exit/kill markers remain.
rollback: Revert the atomic implementation commit; no source compiler semantics or stdlib files are changed.
